designationHistory.name: Upper Souris Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Upper Souris Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7161 on August 27, 1935, as a refuge and breeding ground for migratory birds; it was renamed Upper Souris National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (2007 CCP, which quotes the order and its date) and Pass B (American Presidency Project text, dated August 27, 1935) agree. Renamed by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.

sources.name: FWS, Comprehensive Conservation Plan: Des Lacs, J. Clark Salyer and Upper Souris NWRs (2007), ch. 2
